lines: \paragraph{Capacity control.} PCA reduction of HS features to 384d (79--92\% variance retained) preserves the precision advantage across all four models$^\dagger$ (+16.8 to +23.1pp, all $p{<}0.012$, all HB). Two individual metrics are non-significant: R1-8B BA (+1.3pp, $p{=}0.731$) and QwQ-32B FPR ($-$11.4pp, $p{=}0.038$, below HB threshold). The control provides partial evidence against a pure capacity explanation but does not rule out representation quality differences. Random projection to 384d yields similar results ($\Delta$Prec +8.3 to +20.5pp; \cref{app:random_projection}), further weakening the capacity explanation. E5-Mistral-7B (4096d$\rightarrow$PCA 384d) yields intermediate results (2/4 HB; \cref{app:e5_mistral}), forming a monotonic encoder-quality gradient with MiniLM (4/4) and BGE-large (1/4).

\paragraph{Position mediation.} Position ($t/T$) accounts for 9--20pp of balanced accuracy,\footnote{R1-32B's 20.4pp drop reflects $W{=}1$; at $W{\geq}3$, drops are 9--17pp.} but all models retain non-positional signal above chance (all $p{<}0.001$; \cref{app:position_residual}). Three of four models retain significant non-positional HS advantage (residualized gap +3.7 to +6.9pp, HB corrected); R1-32B's gap is +1.9pp ($p{=}0.914$, $n{=}20$). Temporal windowing reduces position dependence (24.3pp drop at $W{=}3$ vs.\ 16.5pp at $W{=}15$).
